entries.text: My cousin was at {name} that night. Swears the thief was one of the guards
A fence in {place} is already asking silly money for what got nicked
They say {npcname} took it, but {npcname} can barely lift a tankard
The thief left something behind, I hear. A glove, or maybe a hand
Nobody saw the theft because everybody was watching the show. That was the point
Don't go near {name} after dark. Folk who were there that night still cough up ash
The curse only takes liars, they say. Which is why the magistrate left town
{npcname} knows the cure. Ask yourself why {npcname} is still charging for it
My aunt took a pebble home from {name}. Went grey overnight, and the goats went barren
You break it by going back to {name}, apparently. Nobody who tried has come back to say
I heard someone sold their shadow at {name}. Got a good price, too
The contract's real enough. {npcname} keeps it framed above a bar in {place}
Deals struck at {name} always come due at the worst moment. Everyone knows that
They shook on it before the ink was dry. Now watch who starts limping
Whatever they bargained for, the other party got the better end. They always do
It was an inside job. Always is. Someone at {name} got paid very well
{npcname} was stabbed in the back, I heard. Or did the stabbing. Depends who's buying
The traitor's drinking in {place} as we speak, bold as brass
Trust nobody who walked out of {name} that night without a scratch
Friends since childhood, they were. Now one's rich and the other's in a ditch
Someone went missing at {name}, and the search party came back one searcher short
My brother says the missing one's alive, held somewhere in {place}
{npcname} is offering a reward, but won't say for what. Or for whom
Whatever was lost at {name}, three different crews are digging for it now
They'll never find it. Some things vanish because they want to
Something under {name} woke up that night. My dog won't walk past it anymore
It slept for centuries, they say. Now it's asking questions about people
{npcname} saw it open its eyes, and hasn't slept a wink since
My gran says it woke once before, a hundred years back. It ate the mayor
The stones at {name} are warm to the touch now. They never used to be
Something guards {name}. It let the children pass, and nobody else
The old keeper died last winter, and that's when the trouble started
{npcname} is the only one it answers to. Probably why {npcname} drinks
Whatever it guards is worth more than this whole town, I'd wager
The guardian's getting tired. You can tell by the way the lights flicker
It was in the old verses, word for word. {name}, the hour, even the weather
The prophecy has three signs. That was the first. Nobody wants to guess the second
{npcname} keeps telling everyone it was foretold. Suspicious, if you ask me
A seer in {place} named the day years ago, and died the night before it
Half the town thinks it's the end of the world. The other half is selling charms
The hangman's sober for once. That means someone's name has come up
A devil in a fine coat bought drinks all night at {name}. Paid in teeth
An angel was seen weeping on the rooftops. Angels only weep when a vow breaks
The fair folk were laughing at {name}. When they laugh, something's been taken
Grandad's grave was empty the morning after. Always did like a party
A ship went down that same hour. No wreckage, no bodies, nothing at all
The drow traders stopped coming the day after. Drow don't scare easy
The academy has sent apprentices to {name} all week. They're measuring something
The wolves circle {name} but won't go in. Wolves know a cursed place
That ice hasn't moved in a thousand years, and now it's moving
The forges burned blue all week. The smiths say that's a promise being kept
A knight rode through asking about {name}, armour polished like the old days
In Sigil they're taking bets on this. The odds changed the minute it happened
